exclusion_reasons.reason: Wrong Language: Full text not in English, Spanish, Italian or Norwegian
Wrong Document Type: Grey literature, reports, dissertations, commentaries / A review or meta-analysis
Wrong Scope: Not related to agriculture/farming/agri-food systems/food chain

Wrong Conceptual focus: No degrowth framing, Studies on economic growth or sustainability without any degrowth/postgrowth framing / Degrowth term used differently: Studies using degrowth concepts with a different meaning (e.g., degrowth of animal metabolism or body weight)
